result.summary: Produced a unified diff (not a full rewrite) targeting docs/validation/evidence/starter-integration-planning-2026-09-20/candidate-test_starter_structures_metadata.py, written to the sole allowed output path metadata-harness-hardening.patch. The patch: (1) adds one new GDScript assertion per generated case — `assert_equal(StarterStructures.plan_refusal(out), expected_literal, ...)` run unconditionally after prepare_into (covering both the healthy-populated-output-equals-empty-code case and the faulted/untouched-output-equals-source-refusal case) — raising per-case assertion counts to 9 for positive/restored and 18 for each fault (450 total), and pins those exact counts in a new EXPECTED_ASSERTIONS table keyed off a new case_kind_of()/FAULT_NAMES helper; (2) adds a bare "ERROR:" marker to INVALID_MARKERS alongside the existing SCRIPT ERROR:/Parse Error:/Parser Error: markers so generic engine failures are rejected too; (3) rewrites execute() to require, before crediting a case as passed: no invalid-marker text anywhere in the merged output, exactly one parsed summary line, exactly one ##STARTERFAULT## observation line whose case field names the actual case being run, exactly one test, zero failures, the pinned expected assertion count for that case's kind, exit code 0, and every observed static/last/prepared/probe/malformed field matching a new pinned EXPECTED_OBSERVATION table per case kind (fault: all STARTER_SOURCE_METADATA / prepared=false; control: static/last empty, prepared=true, probe=STARTER_BUILDING_LAYOUT, malformed=STARTER_PLAN_SHAPE, matching the actual 26/26 run's observed values) — any single mismatch is recorded in a new `problems` list and the diagnostic `tail` is now attached whenever a case is not passed for any reason (assertion failures, count/marker mismatches, or malformed observations), not only on execution-invalidity; (4) updates the three execute() call sites in main() to pass each case's expected_refusal through; (5) corrects the module docstring's introductory description from "does the following inside a fresh temporary clone" to accurately state that one owned temporary clone is created once and reused across all cases, with each case run as its own separate cold Godot process inside that same clone. All 24 named faults, the 26-case/record total, the real-repository byte-preservation finally-block, and the no-production-modification/no-bypass posture are left completely unchanged; no new test scope was added beyond the requested hardening. This response makes no claim that the patched harness has been applied, executed, or re-verified.
